## 2500 - 2506

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02500">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2500 US - Ultrasonic UFM diagnostic</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02500">

Ultrasonic (US) exceptions are related to the limits defined in the Meter Editor Flowing Parameters Validations tab for gas and liquid meters. These validations are available only for ultrasonic meters as they check ultrasonic meter parameters such as speed of sound, profile, and symmetry. Path Gain validation generates exceptions 2600-2659 . These validations are performed against the data displayed in the UFM Diagnostic tab in the Volume Editor for ultrasonic meters.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02501">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2501 US - Speed of sound is not constant</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02501">

This exception is generated when the Speed of Sound for a UFM Diagnostic record of a ultrasonic meter differs from previous Speed of Sound values by more than the percent difference limit set in the Ultrasonic 2 validation in the Meter Editor. For example, in the Speed of Sound group box on the Ultrasonic 2 sub-tab of the Meter Editor, the Duration (Hours) is set to 5 and the Percent Difference is set to 0.25. For a UFM Diagnostic record for the meter, the Speed of Sound is 399.241149. The Speed of Sound values for the 5 previous records are 397.6949768, 397.8718872, 397.2702636, 398.3409118, and 398.4650268. The percent difference from each record is 0.3888, 0.3441, 0.2438, 0.2260, and 0.1948.  Two exceptions will be generated on the current UFM Diagnostics record since 0.3888 and 0.3441 are greater than 0.25.

This validation and exception are not applicable where the number of records available for the comparison with the current record is less than the Duration (Hours) value.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02502">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2502 US - Speed of sound exceeds variance validation limit</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02502">

This exception is generated when the imported Speed of Sound for a UFM Diagnostic record of a ultrasonic meter differs from the Speed of Sound value calculated by FLOWCAL by more than the limit set in the Ultrasonic 2 validation in the Meter Editor. For example, in the Speed of Sound group box on the Ultrasonic 2 sub-tab of the Meter Editor, the Variance Amount is set to 0.0005 and the Compare Using field is set to Unit Difference. For a UFM Diagnostic record for the meter, the Speed of Sound of Path 1 is 400.08813; the Speed of Sound of Path 2 400.08841; the Speed of Sound of Path 3 400.15152; and the Speed of Sound of Path 4 400.31750; and the imported Speed of Sound is 400.1601. FLOWCAL calculates the Speed of Sound to be the average of the four paths: (400.08813 + 400.08841 + 400.15152 + 400.31750) / 4 = 400.1614. The unit difference between the imported value and the calculated value is 400.1614 – 400.1601 = 0.0013 which is greater than 0.0005, and this exception is generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02503">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2503 US - Flow velocity profile exceeds baseline limit</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02503">

This exception is generated when the Profile of path velocities for a ultrasonic meter can be calculated and the calculated value varies from the Baseline by more than the Percent Difference Allowed set in the Ultrasonic 2 validation in the Meter Editor. The Profile is defined as (Path 2 Velocity + Path 3 Velocity) / (Path 1 Velocity + Path 4 Velocity).

For example, in the Profile group box on the Ultrasonic 2 sub-tab of the Meter Editor, the Baseline is set to 0.9990 and the Percent Difference Allowed is set to 0.1000. For a UFM Diagnostics record, the Path 1 Velocity is 1.14496028; the Path 2 Velocity 1.12940907; the Path 3 Velocity 1.16436565; and the Path 4 Velocity 1.15422022. The Profile is then (1.12940907 + 1.16436565) / (1.14496028 + 1.15422022) = 0.99764882. The variance from the Baseline value is abs(0.99764882 / 0.9990) – 1) \* 100 = 0.1353 %. This exceeds the Percent Difference Allowed value of 0.1000, so the exception is generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02504">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2504 US - Flow velocity symmetry exceeds baseline limit</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02504">

This exception is generated when the Symmetry of path velocities for a ultrasonic meter can be calculated and the calculated value varies from the Baseline by more than the Percent Difference Allowed set in the Ultrasonic 2 validation in the Meter Editor. The Symmetry is defined as (Path 1 Velocity + Path 2 Velocity) / (Path 3 Velocity + Path 4 Velocity).

For example, in the Symmetry group box on the Ultrasonic 2 sub-tab of the Meter Editor, the Baseline is set to 0.9820 and the Percent Difference Allowed is set to 0.1000. For a UFM Diagnostics record, the Path 1 Velocity is 1.14496028; the Path 2 Velocity 1.12940907; the Path 3 Velocity 1.16436565; and the Path 4 Velocity 1.15422022. The Profile is then (1.14496028 + 1.12940907) / (1.16436565 + 1.15422022) = 0.980929534. The variance from the Baseline value is abs (0.980929534 / 0.9990 – 1) \* 100 = 1.8089 %. This exceeds the Percent Difference Allowed value of 0.1000, so the exception is generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02505">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2505 US - Unable to calculate profile</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02505">

This exception is generated when the Profile of path velocities for a ultrasonic meter cannot be calculated and the returned value is null. The Profile is defined as (Path 2 Velocity + Path 3 Velocity) / (Path 1 Velocity + Path 4 Velocity). This exceptions is applicable when the Profile validation values are configured properly on the Ultrasonic 2 validation in the Meter Editor, and the Ultrasonic 2 validation is set to Run on Imports and Edits.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02506">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2506 US - Unable to calculate symmetry</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02506">

This exception is generated when the Symmetry of path velocities for a ultrasonic meter cannot be calculated and the returned value is null. The Symmetry is defined as (Path 1 Velocity + Path 2 Velocity) / (Path 3 Velocity + Path 4 Velocity). This exceptions is applicable when the Symmetry validation values are configured properly on the Ultrasonic 2 validation in the Meter Editor, and the Ultrasonic 2 validation is set to Run on Imports and Edits.

</div>
